name: Elite Logo Showcase – Logo Grid & Logo Carousel, Logo Slider
author: Zamzamcoders

sections.description:
Looking for a tool to showcase your custom logos effortlessly? “Elite Logo Showcase – Display Logos in a Slider, Carousel, or Grid” lets you easily display your selected logos in a slider, carousel, or grid format. It offers customization options.

Set up your WordPress logo display with responsive layouts for slider, carousel, and grid using a guternberg block, and showcase your logos in just a few clicks.

Live Demo Check

Logo Showcase – Gutenberg Blocks and Elementor Addons

GUTENBERG BLOCK

The launch of the Elite Logo Showcase Gutenberg Block empowers the WordPress Gutenberg editor with the ability to create stunning logo displays in multiple layouts, including grids, carousels, and sliders. With a variety of themes, this tool enhances brand visibility in the most effective way.

All the essential features for designing fully responsive and seamless logo sliders, grids, and carousels are already built into your workflow, allowing you to effortlessly showcase brands, partners, and sponsors with ease. 🚀

👉 Features included with Gutenberg Blocks:

  • Responsive logo showcase
  • Custom link each logo
  • 2 different way in logo ( slider & grid )
  • Show hide Logos Elements
  • Autoplay Enable/Disable
  • Infinite Scroll Enable/Disable
  • Show Arrows Enable/Disable
  • Show Dots Enable/Disable
  • Enable Mouse Control
  • Direction Change Left to right/ Right to left
  • Slider Delay options
  • Logo Spacing
  • Easy & Lightweight.
  • Color settings
  • Background Color
  • Icon Color
  • Dot Color
  • Slider Style
  • Grid Logo Style
  • And Many More…

Elementor Addons

Logo Slider Showcase for Elementor lets you display brand logos in a smooth, responsive, and customizable carousel. Perfect for showcasing partners, clients, sponsors, and trusted brands with autoplay, navigation controls, and fully responsive design—no coding required.

👉 Features included with Elementor Addons:

  • Responsive logo showcase
  • Custom link each logo
  • 6 different way in logo slider
  • Show hide Logos Elements
  • Autoplay Enable/Disable
  • Infinite Scroll Enable/Disable
  • Show Arrows Enable/Disable
  • Show Dots Enable/Disable
  • Enable Mouse Control
  • Enable Mousewheel
  • Direction Change Right to left
  • Animation Speed options
  • Logo Spacing
  • Easy & Lightweight.
  • Color settings
  • Background Color
  • Arrow Position Change
  • Dot Position Change
  • Slider Style
  • Width & height Change
  • And Many More…
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

e.g.

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/elite-logo-showcase directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
sections.faq:
Can I customize the plugin?

  • Yes, you can customize the from the plugin settings.

Is the plugin mobile-friendly?

  • Absolutely! The plugin is optimized for mobile devices to provide a superior shopping experience on any device.

Will the plugin work with any WordPress theme?

  • Absolutely! Our plugin is designed to be fully compatible with any WordPress theme. Whether you’re using a free theme or a premium one, the plugin seamlessly integrates with your site’s design, maintaining a consistent look and feel while adding powerful new features.

Is the plugin easy to set up and use?

  • Absolutely! Our plugin is designed for a quick and straightforward setup. With a user-friendly interface and step-by-step guidance, you can configure all the features in just a few minutes, even if you have no technical background. Start enhancing your WooCommerce store effortlessly, right out of the box.
